# openwrt_network_globals (Resource)

Global network options (`config globals`).

Manages a `globals` section in `/etc/config/network`. This section normally exists on a stock router: creating the resource adopts it (renaming an anonymous section to `section`), and destroying the resource only removes it from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.

### Optional

- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `packet_steering` (Number) Packet steering: 0 off, 1 on, 2 all CPUs. (UCI option `packet_steering`.)
- `steering_flows` (Number) Number of RPS flows. (UCI option `steering_flows`.)
- `tcp_l3mdev` (Boolean) Allow TCP sockets in VRFs. (UCI option `tcp_l3mdev`.)
- `udp_l3mdev` (Boolean) Allow UDP sockets in VRFs. (UCI option `udp_l3mdev`.)
- `ula_prefix` (String) IPv6 ULA prefix. (UCI option `ula_prefix`.)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.
